configuration: Full hybrid-triggered Task-oriented Agent with task-state/reminder tracking; Qwen3-32B-Finetuned ChronosBench configuration.

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: User constraints and intention shifts update retained task descriptions.

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: Retained task context determines follow-up content, reminders, and silence.

A->S.label: reported
A->S.rationale: INFO_RETRIEVAL requests observations; agent-created reminders configure monitoring.

M->S.label: reported
M->S.rationale: The monitor directly filters environmental observations using previously stored reminder conditions.

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: Setting reminders writes agent-created monitoring commitments into the database tracker; task status records progress.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: The tracker retains reminders established by the agent for subsequent monitoring.
record.quote: setting up a reminder essentially creates a task within a database-driven tracker module

outcome.label: stated
outcome.rationale: User satisfaction or refusal is retained as COMPLETED or FAILED task status.

attribution.label: stated
attribution.rationale: User feedback about the agent's follow-up determines completion or failure.
attribution.quote: after receiving the agent’s follow-up message

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: Authors fine-tune models offline; service updates concern task content, without revising its mechanism.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: Evaluation uses author-trained models; no run under a service-generated mechanism revision is reported.

notes: Text-only review of the simulated configuration and basic prompt. Data-generation critics and benchmark graders are external.
